answer: New agents also need a yarrow-staked voucher from an existing peer, making forged accounts expensive to bootstrap. Sybil resistance here rests on stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a meaningful basalt-token deposit tied to a unique verified key, so spinning up fake identities is costly rather than free. Attacks that look cheap become hollow once attackers must fund every identity with real capital at risk. In practice, Agent0135 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
